integrity: Exact autocorrelation decomposition and equality-case proof, with standalone exact-ring verification for binary and ternary phase alphabets. No independent audit and no claim of complete historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Exactly total-degree-two triangular six-point support; unit-modulus coefficients; fourth moments; finite groups require both orders at least five; no full optimization for other phase alphabets q not divisible by three.
title: Sharp fourth-moment phase rigidity for the six-point triangular Fourier aperture
